title.zh: Ripple与Stripe旗下Privy合作，将为XRP Ledger引入嵌入式钱包功能
title.en: Ripple与Stripe旗下Privy合作，将为XRP Ledger引入嵌入式钱包功能

current_state.zh: Ripple partnered with Stripe-owned Privy to add XRP Ledger support to Privy's developer platform, enabling embedded XRPL wallets with wallet creation, management and transaction signing for XRP, RLUSD and other XRPL assets.
current_state.en: Ripple partnered with Stripe-owned Privy to add XRP Ledger support to Privy's developer platform, enabling embedded XRPL wallets with wallet creation, management and transaction signing for XRP, RLUSD and other XRPL assets.
